verdict.rationale: Credential management is a plausible feature for a developer-platform mobile client, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Mobile issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens for agents. The only related items are platform-level REST/GraphQL APIs and Copilot agent task management, which are host-platform or adjacent features, not credential issuance within the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
